required_findings.meaning: The exact candidate has no successful rollback rehearsal; policy requires one.
An unresolved high-severity authorization finding blocks deployment without an exception.

validation_design: Check the workload-result schema, exact run/task/revision identity, hold verdict, required finding IDs/severities, source existence and required source bindings. Evaluate semantic assertions against these fixture facts; do not accept a response solely because it repeats finding IDs. Semantic validation implementation remains a build ticket.
